title: Accessible Quickshare panel — keyboard, contrast, and i18n prototype review
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Summary: This ticket covers a design prototype and accessibility/localization review for a new 'Quickshare' panel in the Redwood Console. The Quickshare panel is intended to let users: generate a time-bounded dashboard snapshot, copy a locale-aware share URL, toggle inclusion of cost breakdowns, choose share language/template for email, and export a PNG thumbnail. Goal: ship a share experience that is keyboard-first, screen-reader friendly, color-contrast safe, and resilient to localization expansions and RTL locales.

Why now: Several customer requests for easily sharing dashboards plus an internal accessibility audit flagged the current ad-hoc share modal as failing keyboard flow and having hard-coded microcopy that breaks in translations. This prototype is a low-risk UX iteration to land accessibility fixes before engineering implements the backend share token endpoint and localized templates (ENG-20345 / ENG-20911).
acceptance_criteria: Panel is a proper dialog (role=dialog + aria-modal=true) and traps focus while open
Initial focus placed on first interactive control (Share URL input) and focus returns to trigger button on close
All interactive controls reachable and operable by keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Space/Enter) without reliance on pointer hover
Copy-to-clipboard action announces success via an assertive aria-live region (aria-live=polite/ assertive depending on platform test) and has a visible toast fallback for AT users
All microcopy strings are externalized (no concatenated strings in markup) and pass basic translation spot-checks in German, Spanish, and Arabic
Number, currency, date and duration formats displayed in the UI follow the user locale; examples updated in the prototype for en-US, de-DE, and ar-SA
Color tokens used in the panel meet WCAG AA contrast ratios with the current theme; critical badges (e.g., 'cost included') pass a 4.5:1 ratio
PNG snapshot thumbnail has alt text describing date range and snapshot size, and thumbnail control has a keyboard focus ring
Prototype includes tests for long translations (up to +40% length) and Arabic RTL layout to ensure no clipping or overlap
Design handoff includes a small QA checklist and Playwright accessibility checks for the happy path
comments: 2025-02-11 — Riley Kapoor: initial sketching review. Suggested changing 'Include costs' label to 'Include cost breakdown' for clarity; flagged potential translation length in German. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/quickshare-proto

2025-02-18 — Maya Singh: updated prototype with role=dialog and focus trapping. Added aria-describedby to link input for instructions. PRD link: https://company.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/78901234/Quickshare+PRD

2025-02-24 — Eng notes (ENG-20345): backend token TTL will be 24h by default; UI needs quick TTL picker (1h / 24h / 7d) — added to prototype. GitHub draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4192

2025-03-01 — Accessibility review by Samira Ortiz: verified keyboard order but found announcement timing when copying is not consistent on NVDA; recommended aria-live="assertive" for Windows+NVDA and testing VoiceOver timing. Also noted tooltip hover interactions must have keyboard equivalents

2025-03-02 — Maya Singh: updated copy strings to avoid runtime interpolation inside the label (moved interpolation into data-attrs). Added i18n test cases for Arabic and plural forms for 'shared items' message.
design_decisions: Use a three-option TTL selector (1h / 24h / 7d) to avoid free-form inputs that complicate localization and microcopy
Prefer an input-with-copy button pattern (readonly input + 'Copy' button) rather than inline link anchors to ensure predictable keyboard focus and consistent announcement patterns

Export thumbnail action placed at the far end of the dialog to reduce accidental activation when keyboard navigating; keyboard shortcut offered (Alt+S) documented in tooltip and accessible via button aria-keyshortcuts
Avoid concatenated strings in UI; prefer ICU templates at interpolation boundary to make translators' lives easier and support plural rules
accessibility_findings: Initial prototype failed focus return on modal close (fixed) — regression prevented keyboard users from continuing work in console
Copy-to-clipboard had no screenreader feedback — added aria-live region and visible toast fallback
Color token used for 'Included' badge had contrast ratio of 3.2:1 against surface; replaced with a darker token to reach 4.6:1
Tooltip timing was hover-only and disappeared when keyboard focus moved; changed tooltips to persistent on focus and dismissible via Esc
PNG thumbnail lacked alt text; added templated alt that includes date range and pixel size for assistive description
localization_notes: All new strings must be pulled into i18n catalog; avoid inline concatenation (e.g., avoid: 'Shared by ' + userName)
Email subject templates support a {locale} variant; UI must expose language selector that maps to language-specific subject/body templates (work with PM on PM-412)
Date/duration examples in the prototype show localized formats (e.g., 03/12/2025 vs 12.03.2025 and Arabic-Indic numerals for ar-SA) — frontend to use Intl.DateTimeFormat and Intl.NumberFormat
Careful with German nouns that expand ~30–40% and with Arabic bidi contexts: snapshot thumbnails and CTA buttons may need adaptive layout to avoid wrapping truncation
Pluralization: '1 recipient' vs '0 recipients' vs '2 recipients' uses CLDR pluralization; validate for languages with 3+ plural forms (Slavic languages)
keyboard_flow: Open panel: Trigger button receives aria-haspopup and aria-controls
Focus order: Share URL input -> TTL selector -> Include cost toggle -> Language selector -> Export PNG button -> Recipient input / Copy -> Primary 'Share' button -> Close button
Shortcuts: Escape closes dialog and returns focus; Enter on copy button activates copy; Alt+S opens Export PNG action; Shift+Tab wraps properly to previous interactive item
screenreader_announce_pattern: On open: 'Quickshare dialog opened. Press Escape to close. Export snapshot, copy link, or share with recipients.' When Copy pressed: 'Link copied to clipboard. Link expires in 24 hours.' On share success: 'Dashboard snapshot shared to X recipients.' Errors use role=alert and speak error messages with guidance.
front_end_todo: Implement focus trap util and ensure focus return: see ENG-20911
Add aria-live region with ID and wire copy success messages: ENG-20345
Replace problematic color token with token 'interactive.badge.high-contrast' and add theming test
Externalize strings into i18n catalog and add ICU templates for subject/body: work with PM-412
Add Playwright e2e to assert keyboard navigation and aria attributes (tests in ci/a11y/quickshare.spec.ts)
Add RTL visual regression snapshots for ar-SA and he-IL in Percy
qa_checks: Keyboard-only walkthrough (no mouse) passes for full share flow
Screen reader walkthroughs on NVDA and VoiceOver for en-US and ar-SA samples
Contrast verification for badge and CTA colors (automated axe + manual color contrast tool)
Translation sanity checks for German and Arabic with +40% copy expansion
Playwright assertions for aria attributes and toast announcements
estimated_impact_metrics: Reduction in reported share-flow keyboard regressions by 90% in staged beta users
Fewer localization tickets related to share microcopy after rollout (target: 0 critical l10n regressions)
Faster share completion time for keyboard users (target: 15% improvement)
